delta_definition: WMSE(model) - WMSE(Mean), paired on fold and condition; lower is better
figure_contract: One quantitative comparison panel: add PRESAGE to the original ten rows, without changing original marks, labels, typography, colors, title, xlabel or annotation format. Python/matplotlib. Original width 7.2 in, 160 dpi PNG plus PDF; height follows original 0.42*n+1.2 formula.
adaptation: Structural adaptation of original script; only PRESAGE appended to data/calculations; output filenames changed; original plotting block otherwise unchanged.
mean_reference: Red dashed zero line only, not a row or comparison

bootstrap.sampling: One sequential NumPy default_rng stream in original ten-model iteration order, then PRESAGE; original per-source row order retained; no canonical resort before sampling
bootstrap.unit: paired perturbation, pooled across five folds

significance.test: two-sided one-sample t-test of paired model-minus-Mean differences
significance.old_adjusted_p_change: 11/10 of original ten-comparison values; raw p, t, mu and CI unchanged
significance.display: original adjusted-P and signed-t code, unchanged

original_ten_consistency.png_limit: Image annotations only expose rounded adjusted P and t; exact underlying values are established by rerunning the unchanged original calculation source; full original image reconstruction matches every RGBA pixel.

coverage.key_hash_definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON sorted [int(fold),str(condition)] pairs with separators comma/colon

caveats: User explicitly requested preserving the original Technical duplicate, Interpolated duplicate and Control mean WMSE scores on their 8370-gene axis, paired with 8369-gene Mean on identical perturbation keys. This mixed-axis comparison is retained unchanged, not a strict common-gene-axis benchmark.
No retraining or rescoring. Of 2029 source perturbations per auxiliary baseline, only the original 1802 final_common keys are retained; no requested cohort member is dropped.
Bootstrap and t-test pool perturbations across folds; shared fitted models can induce dependence. Intervals reflect perturbation variability, not independent training replicates.
The prior figures/k562_wmse_forest_vs_mean.meta.json was overwritten by the nine-row variant and is not evidence for the supplied ten-row reference.
